cross_verification.note_en: Consulado de México en Boston (consulmex.sre.gob.mx), operated by Mexico's Secretaría de Relaciones Exteriores (SRE), was fetched directly and applies the same photo spec text identically across its Non-Paid Activities (Tourist), Lucrative Activities (Work), Permanent Resident, Temporary Resident, and Student visa pages: '39 x 31 mm or 2 x 2 inches, front view, no eyeglasses and white background.' NOTE: the source page's own '2 x 2 inches' co-notation is NOT mathematically equivalent to 39x31mm (2x2in = 50.8x50.8mm, a ~12mm discrepancy, likely boilerplate carried over from the unrelated US 2x2in passport-photo standard) — the inch figure was therefore dropped from verified.size.value per the truthfulness gate and only the explicit 39x31mm figure retained. A separate INM (Instituto Nacional de Migración) official PDF (inm.gob.mx/micrositio/1/docs/ficha/01-es.pdf), which covers visas requested directly at INM for family-unity/humanitarian/job-offer cases, was also read in full (12 pages) and does NOT mention any photo requirement at all for those specific INM-direct categories — so that document was not used as a conflicting source, since it addresses a different visa-application channel. Other search-indexed SRE consulate pages (not independently fetched in this pass) cite a range of '32.0mm x 26mm (min) to 39.0mm x 31.0mm (max)', consistent with the Boston consulate's 39x31mm figure as an upper bound; this was not added to verified since it was not independently confirmed by direct fetch.
